page.content:
Jurassic plated dinosaur of the Morrison Formation.

How Stegosaurus connects

  • Topic: Stegosauria — Stegosaurus is the type genus of Stegosauria.
  • Location: Morrison Formation — Stegosaurus is a signature plated dinosaur of the Morrison.

What is Stegosaurus?

Stegosaurus carried two rows of plates and a thagomizer tail. It is the public face of Stegosauria and a staple of Colorado and Utah Morrison quarries.

Key threads lead to Stegosauria and Morrison Formation.
